text: Heads up for anyone touching ui/imgui/: ui/imgui/DESIGN.md was stale (proposed a from-scratch "workspace bar" redesign that contradicts the current port-host-verbatim plan). Marked SUPERSEDED with a banner pointing to docs/GUI_MIGRATION_DAG.md + HANDOFF_GUI_OVERHAUL.md + host/src/ui/ as the real reference. If your build/screenshots of ui/imgui show the old Model/Sheet Metal/Weldment/Surface/Simulate workspace bar or a "demo mode/engine offline" viewport instead of host's ribbon tabs, that's this stale doc's influence — port host's actual look, don't redesign. Details on T-G11.
